headline: Steady Q2; Improved pricing power to aid growth ahead

highlights: (LEMTRE) CMP: ₹123 Target ₹ 150 (22%) Target Period: 12 months November 13, 2026 Steady Q2; Improved pricing power to aid growth ahead… About the stock : Lemon Tree Hotels (LTHL) is India’s largest hotel chain in the mid-priced hotel sector.
Q 2F Y2 7 performance : LTHL’s consolidated revenues reported 18% YoY growth to Rs.361.4cr in Q2FY27.
RevPAR growth was largely balanced between occupancy (+633bps YoY) and ADR (+8% YoY).
EBITDA grew by 22.2% YoY to Rs.159.7cr and PAT grew by 51% YoY to Rs.63.5cr.
valuation: (LEMTRE) CMP: ₹123 Target ₹ 150 (22%) Target Period: 12 months November 13, 2026 Steady Q2; Improved pricing power to aid growth ahead… About the stock : Lemon Tree Hotels (LTHL) is India’s largest hotel chain in the mid-priced hotel sector.
The company is targeting annual room opening of ~2,000 rooms in FY27 and ~2,500 rooms from FY28 onwards, largely through the management and franchise model.
Rating and Target Price : We recommend Buy with a revised price target of Rs. 150 valuing it at 2 2x its FY28E EV/EBITDA (adjusting for 59% stake in Fleur Hotel).
watch: Further, renovation-led improvements are driving stronger performance across the portfolio, particularly at Keys, where RevPAR grew 29% YoY, while renovated properties in Delhi reported over 30% growth.

With ~80% of the Keys renovation programme completed and the share of revenue from rooms priced above Rs.7,500 increasing from ~48% to 50%, the company is witnessing improving pricing power and a favourable portfolio mix.
